messages:
Elaine: OK team — picking final angle for the April webinar. I sketched 3 audience-first abstracts, want quick thumbs and a preferred speaker pairing.

Mark: send the 3, elaine. we should lock by EOD so invites go tomorrow. :calendar:

Elaine: 1) "Serving Economics: How to cut per-token costs without hurting UX" — target: platform PMs/infra leads. short demo of batching + cache.

Elaine: 2) "Consistent Inference: From dev to private deployment" — target: enterprise app teams. focus on Dedicated/Private rollouts + SLA examples.

Elaine: 3) "Benchmarks that Matter: Real workloads, real tradeoffs" — target: engineering leads evaluating models. deep-dive on latency/cost numbers, honest failure modes.

Anika: I like #3 for lead quality, but #1 sounds more approachable for PLG signups. maybe run both but different messaging in ads?

Jorge: agree w/anika. we can A/B landing page copy: one emphasizes unit costs, other emphasizes reliability.

Zara: speaker recs: for #1 — DevRel + Perf engineer (Sam + Priya). for #3 — Research lead + Customer case (Maya + Arjun).

Mark: +1 to pairing. who can do the live benchmark? it's risky but compelling. we should have a canned recording fallback. :warning:

Elaine: good call. plan: live run with synthetic trace + recorded fallback clip. rehearsal checklist: 1) bench script in repo 2) pre-warm test infra 3) fallback clip queued 4) QA monitoring dashboards visible.

Anika: can someone create a short `runbook.md` for stage ops? I'll own the backstage cues and handoff notes.

Jorge: I'll add runbook and bench script to `marketing/webinars/bench` this afternoon. snippet will include the exact commands we run so ops can replicate.

Zara: audience segmentation idea: invite a high-touch list (trial accounts >10k tokens/day) + broad PLG list. route high-touch leads to AE queue with tag `webinar:bench-deep-dive`.

Elaine: perfect — add `utm=bench_deep` + a hidden form field `tier=trial_high_touch` so we can auto-route. Mark, can growth ops wire the AE tag?

Mark: pinging @deploy-bot to create the routing rule in lead ingest. deploy-bot: please create rule `webinar_bench_high_touch` to map hidden field -> AE queue.

deploy-bot: created rule `webinar_bench_high_touch` -> AE queue. ID 77021. verify in CRM.

Anika: rehearsal schedule proposal: tech run Tue (30m), full dress Thu (45m), dry-run Mon of event week (20m). who needs calendar invites?

Elaine: add Sam, Priya, Maya, Arjun, Prod PM, Growth Ops, Stage Ops. I'll draft a short run-of-show timeline next (5 min intro, 15 min bench, 10 min customer, 10 min q&a, 5 min wrap).

Jorge: tiny ask — can we include a 1-slide appendix with quantization caveats and fallback perf numbers? keeps questions bounded.

Zara: yes, and prepare two CTA options: 1) sign up for Dedicated eval 2) request private demo. we'll test which converts better post-webinar.

Elaine: great. last Q: any strong objections to selecting abstract #3 for main marketing copy and offering #1 as a follow-up deep-dive track?

Mark: no objections. sounds like a solid funnel. :thumbsup:

Anika: ok locked. I'll update the copy and landing page draft by 17:00. thanks everyone!
